formal_slots.name: lambda
formal_slots.child_types: one body whose inferred type is the result of a -> b
formal_slots.contract: bind one input and extend the de Bruijn environment

formal_slots.name: application
formal_slots.child_types: function a -> b and argument a; result b by unification

formal_slots.name: bound_variable
formal_slots.child_types: one in-scope de Bruijn index with unifiable type
formal_slots.contract: reference only a lexically bound variable

formal_slots.name: semantic_function_reference
formal_slots.child_types: one visible primitive or admitted composite F with its type scheme
formal_slots.contract: call only an existing capability; no task-specific operator is introduced
formal_slots.dreamcoder_expression: Primitive (or a learned grammar production after accumulation)

slot_semantics: Each emitted AST node consumes one generic production slot; slots contain syntax only, not values, examples, goals, or task-specific operators.
global_type_rule: Hindley-Milner-style polymorphic type instantiation and application unification; ill-typed ASTs are rejected.

public_contract.alpha_binding: the runtime batch of visible input instances; never persisted in F

design_basis: General expression constructors required to represent the same typed lambda-calculus programs used by DreamCoder's list grammar.
